en: an operation that involves removing material from the inside of the uterus or other body part using a small sharp tool
ex: Surgical removal with curettage is the standard treatment.
刮除手术是标准治疗方法。

en: a small tool that is used to remove material from the body, especially from the uterus

zh: 儿童晚间必须在家的时间
en: a law that says that people must not go outside after a particular time at night until the morning; the time after which nobody must go outside
ex: The army imposed a dusk-to-dawn curfew.
军队强制实行黄昏至黎明的宵禁。

en: a unit for measuring radioactivity
a small object that is rare or unusual, often something that people collect

zh: 罕见而有趣之物；奇物；珍品
en: a strong desire to know about something
ex: Children show curiosity about everything.
儿童对一切事物都显露出好奇心。

en: having a strong desire to know about something
ex: He is such a curious boy, always asking questions.
他这个孩子求知欲很强，总是爱提问。

en: in a way that shows a strong desire to know about something
ex: ‘Are you really an artist?’ Sara asked curiously.
“你真是画家吗？” 萨拉好奇地问道。

en: a chemical element. Curium is a radioactive metal produced artificially from plutonium.

zh: （使）呈螺旋（或卷曲）状移动；（使）旋绕；缭绕
en: to form or make something form into a curl or curls
ex: His hair curls naturally.
他的头发天生鬈曲。

en: to lie or sit with your back curved and your arms and legs bent close to your body
ex: She curled up and closed her eyes.
她蜷成一团，闭上了眼睛。

en: a small plastic or metal tube that you can wrap wet hair around in order to make it curly
ex: She put her hair in curlers at night.
她晚上把头发放在卷发器里。

en: a bird with a long thin beak that curves downwards, that lives near water
an attractive curve or twist in writing or in a design

zh: 冰壶，冰上溜石（将重石片滑向一目标）
en: a game played on ice, in which players slide heavy flat stones towards a mark
a tool that is heated and used to curl hair

zh: 有鬈发（或毛）的；拳曲状的
en: having a lot of curls or a curved shape
ex: long curly hair
长长的卷发

en: a plant with green curly leaves that are eaten raw as a vegetable

zh: 脾气坏的人（常指老年人）
en: a person who gets annoyed easily, often an old person
easily annoyed

葡萄干小圆面包
